articles.title: Aces star targets heckling Fever fans in Indy before Chelsea Gray stuns Caitlin Clark in OT thriller - Fox News
articles.description: Jackie Young called for security to remove two courtside fans as the Las Vegas Aces edged the Indiana Fever 86-84 in a dramatic overtime thriller.
articles.content:
This is the most the WNBA has done to keep men out of its sport.
During Thursday night's WILD battle between the Indiana Fever and Las Vegas Aces at Gainbridge Fieldhouse, venue security confronted … [+2812 chars]
